name: Southern Savage Coast
summary: Along the Southern Savage Coast, jungle opens onto beaches and South Seas waters. Travelers face danger from wildlife, naga, and raiders.

sections.title: A Treacherous Shoreline
sections.body: The Southern Savage Coast follows the western edge of southern Stranglethorn. Warm South Seas currents meet the mainland, and the Vile Reef with its submerged ruins divides this shore from the northern Savage Coast. Inlets lie near the Gurubashi Arena and Nek'mani Wellspring; the coast then runs past Booty Bay to Janeiro's Point. The beaches give you more room than the jungle, but reptilian predators prowl the sand, naga hunt in the shallows, and corsairs watch for easy prey.

faq.q: Where does the Southern Savage Coast begin and end?
faq.answer: The Southern Savage Coast begins below the Vile Reef and runs south along Stranglethorn Vale's southwestern shore. It passes Booty Bay and Janeiro's Point before meeting the Wild Shore.

faq.q: How is it different from the northern Savage Coast?
aliases: difference between savage coast and southern
faq.answer: The Vile Reef divides the two coasts. The northern Savage Coast follows the Great Sea waters off northern Stranglethorn, while the Southern Savage Coast borders the South Seas along the lower cape.

faq.q: What threats can travelers expect along the beach?
faq.answer: Vicious basilisk lizards and snapping crocolisks roam the open sand. Hostile naga emerge from the shallows, and territorial pirates patrol the coast.

faq.q: Does Booty Bay control this coastline?
aliases: does booty bay own the beach
faq.answer: No. The Blackwater Raiders and Steamwheedle Cartel control Booty Bay's harbor and its immediate approaches. The wild beaches to the north and south remain lawless, untamed territory.

angles.text: As a hunter, you find clear tracking ground on the wide beaches, where amphibious game, coastal cats, and basilisks roam. The open shore gives you better sightlines than the close brush inland.
